leadText:
Karna's Poké Ball factory (Japanese: カーナのモンスターボール工場 Karna's Monster Ball factory) is an -exclusive location in the Galar region. Before visiting the factory, it was seen afar by the Rising Volt Tacklers, where they met Karna, who runs the factory.

Her craftsmanship allows her to create many unique s. After meeting Orla, many issues within it were resolved. After Roy accidentally angered a group of , Friede calmed them down by having them absorb contaminants from the factory's smokestack.
